answer: Re-attestations are stored in garden and tide lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the pigment graph. Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 14 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 836 impostors cost 1486 times the honest price and take 21 times as long to clear.
